text: Sharing works for one or two people. For a whole department, you package content into an app instead.
Apps show up in their own list, distinct from the workspace they came from. Users can filter and drill into them, but never modify what's underneath.
Every app starts from Create app, right there in the workspace list view — one level up from the workspace itself.
Setup captures the name, description, and theme — the first thing app users see before they even open it.
Audiences are the real power here. A Sales team audience and a Product team audience can see completely different content, from the exact same app.
One published app, many possible views. Lesson 74 covers the last piece — dashboards themselves, back in the Power BI service.
